# Supplier (Cin7 Core API v2)

Group `Supplier` of the Cin7 Core API reference. Base URL `https://inventory.dearsystems.com/ExternalApi/v2/`; every request carries the `api-auth-accountid` and `api-auth-applicationkey` headers (see `../api-basics.md`). 4 actions on 2 resources, 2 field tables.

| Action | Path |
|---|---|
| [GET](#get-supplier) | `GET /supplier?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&ID={ID}&Name={Name}&ModifiedSince={ModifiedSince}&IncludeDeprecated={IncludeDeprecated}` |
| [POST](#post-supplier) | `POST /supplier` |
| [PUT](#put-supplier) | `PUT /supplier` |
| [GET](#get-ref-supplier-deposits) | `GET /ref/supplier/deposits?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&SupplierID={SupplierID}&ShowUsedDeposits={ShowUsedDeposits}` |


Supplier CRUD operations

### Available Fields for Supplier
| Property              | Type      | Length    | Required  | Notes                                                             |
|:----------------------|-----------|-----------|-----------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `ID`                  | Guid      |           | Yes       | Unique Supplier ID.                                               |
| `Name`                | String    | 256       | Yes       | Name of Supplier.                                                 |
| `Currency`            | String    |           | Yes       | Currency code of Supplier.                                        |
| `PaymentTerm`         | String    |           | Yes       | PaymentTerm name.                                                 |
| `AccountPayable`      | String    |           | Yes       | AccountPayable code of Supplier.                                  |
| `TaxRule`             | String    |           | Yes       | TaxRule name.                                                     |
| `Status`              | String    |           | Yes*      | Points that Supplier is Active. Can be `Active` or `Deprecated`   |
| `Discount`            | Int       |           |           | Discount must be between 0% and 100%. 0% used as default.         |
| `Comments`            | String    | 256       |           | Comments.                                                         |
| `TaxNumber`           | Int       |           |           | TaxNumber.                                                        |
| `AttributeSet`        | String    |           |           | AttributeSet name.                                                |
| `AdditionalAttribute#`| String    |           |           | Additional attribute value. # - int(1-10).                        |
| `LastModifiedOn`      | String    |           |           | Date of last modification.                                        |
| `Addresses`           |<a href="#SupplierAddressModel"><b>[] Supplier Address Model</b></a>||| List of addresses.             |
| `Contacts`            |<a href="#SupplierContactModel"><b>[] Supplier Contact Model</b></a>||| List of contacts.              |

## Supplier

Path: `/supplier`

<a id="get-supplier"></a>
### GET /supplier?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&ID={ID}&Name={Name}&ModifiedSince={ModifiedSince}&IncludeDeprecated={IncludeDeprecated}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `ID` (optional, Guid): Only return Supplier with the specific ID
  - default: null
- `Name` (optional, string): Only return Suppliers which name starts with the specific name
  - default: null
- `ModifiedSince` (optional, DateTime?): Only return Suppliers modified since specified date (UTC time) in ISO 8601 format.
  - default: null
- `IncludeDeprecated` (optional, bool): Returns all Suppliers, including deprecated, if set to true. If set to false or if it is not specified then returns only active (ie. non-deprecated) Suppliers"
  - default: false

## Supplier Deposits

Path: `/ref/supplier/deposits`

### Available fields for Supplier Deposits
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `DepositID`  | Guid           |         |     |  Deposit ID, identifier unique key.  |
| `SupplierID`  | Guid           |         |     |  Supplier ID|
| `SupplierName`  | String           |         |    | Supplier name.  |
| `Account`  | String           |         |    | Deposit account.  |
| `Amount`  | Decimal           |         |     | Deposit amount.  |
| `RemainingAmount`  | Decimal           |         |    |Deposit remaining amount.  |
| `Currency`  | String           |         |    | Deposit currency name.  |
| `ConvRate`  | Decimal           |         |    | Currency conversion rate.  |
| `Date`  | Date           |         |    | Date paid |
| `Description`  | String           |         |    | Deposit description |

<a id="get-ref-supplier-deposits"></a>
### GET /ref/supplier/deposits?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&SupplierID={SupplierID}&ShowUsedDeposits={ShowUsedDeposits}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `SupplierID` (optional, Guid): Only return Supplier Deposits for specified SupplierID.
  - default: null
- `ShowUsedDeposits` (optional, Boolean): Return Supplier Deposits icluded already used.
  - default: false

Response 200:

```json

  "SupplierDeposits": [
```
